subject: SignalWorks integration — lead crediting & tiered payouts
messages:
From: Samantha Ng <samantha.ng@signalworks.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Ortega <alex@signalworks.com>, partner-success@signalworks.com
Date: 2026-08-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Intro: SignalWorks <> Redwood pilot & revenue-sharing approach

Hi Rachel — great chatting earlier in the week. Per our follow-up, attaching a short note on how we typically structure partner payouts for ISV integrations.

High level: we run a staged onboarding (dev -> beta -> GA) with milestone payments tied to activation events. For our partners we prefer a two-track crediting approach: referral (intro-only) at 7–10% and co-sell/reseller at 15–20% depending on seat thresholds. We also ask for a 90-day lead protection window after registration.

Can you confirm Redwood's preferred stance on: (1) lead registration window, (2) when payout triggers (signed PO vs. first invoice vs. live traffic), and (3) whether Redwood can do partial payouts tied to milestones? We want to draft something mutual for your legal team.

Attached: SignalWorks_MOU_template.docx (their boilerplate).

Thanks,
Samantha
Partner Ops — SignalWorks Labs
attachments: SignalWorks_MOU_template.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Ng <samantha.ng@signalworks.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-18T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: SignalWorks <> Redwood pilot & revenue-sharing approach

Hi Samantha — thanks for the summary and the template. Quick answers up front:
- Lead registration window: Redwood typically grants 120 days of lead protection for registered leads, with an opt-in for exclusive registration on named accounts.
- Payout trigger: we prefer payout on first paid invoice (simpler for tracking), but are open to staged milestone payments if both legal and finance sign off.
- Partial payouts: workable — common approach is 50% on first invoice, 50% on 6-month retention milestone.

Marissa / Ben — looping you to confirm whether 120 days is ok from partner ops perspective and to receive any redline guidance versus their 90-day ask. Karthik — please flag any technical gating that should appear as a payout milestone (e.g., completed SSO integration, provisioning API live).

Rachel
Sr. Partner Manager, Redwood Inference
attachments: none

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-19T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: SignalWorks <> Redwood pilot & revenue-sharing approach

Rachel — quick notes from partner ops: 120 days is acceptable, but we should include a lead qualification clause (MQL -> SQL conversion timeframe) so partners can't farm low-quality contacts for protection. Suggest: partner must register lead with basic qualification fields and Redwood has 14 days to accept or flag.

For payments: finance prefers invoice-based triggers. We can support a two-stage payout (30% on first invoice, 70% on first renewal) for co-sell where Redwood invoices directly. For referral-only (intro) keep a flat 8% at first invoice.

Also attaching a starter MOU that merges SignalWorks language with our payment terms — see SignalWorks_MOU_draft_v1.docx and integration-schedule.xlsx. I'll put the leadflow diagram on Drive.

Marissa
Partner Ops Lead
attachments: SignalWorks_MOU_draft_v1.docx, integration-schedule.xlsx

From: Alex Ortega <alex@signalworks.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samantha Ng <samantha.ng@signalworks.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-20T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: SignalWorks <> Redwood pilot & revenue-sharing approach

Thanks all — appreciate the quick turnaround. A few clarifying items from SignalWorks legal/finance:
1) The 120-day protection is fine if we define "engaged opportunity" (e.g., discovery call + proposal) to supercede protection — we don't want conflicts when a deal is already in active sales motion.
2) For milestone payouts, can Redwood define the technical milestones specifically? We propose: (a) SDK integration complete (dev env), (b) SSO + provisioning in staging, (c) GA with >1 customer using integration. Payout split: 40% on (a), 30% on (b), 30% on (c).
3) Lead registration: SignalWorks prefers a 5-business-day acknowledgment from Redwood to lock the lead.

Also, one ask: would Redwood consider a higher referral % (10%) for managed-service introductions where SignalWorks supplies professional services?

Looking forward to the merged MOU.

—Alex

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-21T09:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: SignalWorks <> Redwood pilot & revenue-sharing approach

Looping in Legal (Laura) for redlines; quick internal stance from finance/ops: we can accept milestone-based payouts but need to limit payment schedule complexity. Proposed compromise: 25% on SDK integration complete, 25% on staging (SSO/provisioning), 50% on GA + first invoice. This reduces split lines and ties final payout to cash receipt.

On lead protection: accept 120-day window with the following guardrails: (1) partner must provide MQL data at registration, (2) Redwood has 10 business days to acknowledge and flag, (3) if we had a pre-existing active opp (logged in HubSpot with activity prior to registration), protection is void.

Laura — please advise on standard clause language for "active opportunity" and any compliance flags on 120-day protection.

Ben
Head of Partnerships Operations
attachments: leadflow-diagram.png

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Alex Ortega <alex@signalworks.com>, Samantha Ng <samantha.ng@signalworks.com>
Date: 2026-08-22T16:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: SignalWorks <> Redwood pilot & revenue-sharing approach

Thanks everyone — legal reviewed the draft MOU and signalworks template. High-level redlines we will send in DocuSign-ready form:
- Define "Registered Lead" (fields required) and include 14-day acceptance window; if no response, auto-accept.
- Define "Active Opportunity" as any HubSpot record with opportunity stage beyond Discovery or with documented proposal signed by customer. This will void protection.
- Payout timing: final tranche released upon receipt of first paid invoice; interim tranches payable on completion of defined technical milestones as evidenced by JIRA tickets closed and staging acceptance sign-off.
- For managed-service referrals: referral rate set at 10% for revenue generated solely from PS scope, and 8% for product ARR introductions.

We'll attach a clean MOU (SignalWorks_MOU_draft_v2.docx) and a DocuSign link for signature. If SignalWorks agrees, we can move to a 2-week review and sign cadence and start scheduling technical onboarding next month.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
attachments: SignalWorks_MOU_draft_v2.docx
